decisions.reason: The INA219 measurement position does not change the standalone USB power source, activation condition, capacity, or powered scope.
Placing the INA219 after the Schottky diodes does not change the OR-ing method, participating power sources, or source-selection behavior.
The same-message MODIFY already fully records the board order and the main board's local-consumption and downstream-forwarding behavior; no additional change is required.
The message references existing interboard connectors only to describe the power path and does not alter the connector inventory, count, or pin-count policy.
The 3.3V current-monitoring topology does not change the addressable LEDs' 5V supply, switching GPIO, or logic-level shifting.
The source decision does not change any panel control, connector mode, button placement, or GPIO mapping.
The INA219 placement and current coverage do not alter the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
The source concerns the main board's 3.3V measurement path and does not change the switched 5V boost supply, enable control, or powered loads.
The word 'series' describes the INA219 power-path placement and has no effect on the separate I2C series-resistor topology or population policy.
The downstream main-board measurement topology does not change the battery connector, pinout, voltage range, placement, or AXP2101 destination.
The source decision introduces no GPIO assignment or GPIO compatibility change.
The INA219 measurement position does not change the battery-charge indicator, CHGLED connector, resistor values, or LED GPIO.
